part.text: {"items":[{"index":1,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"NA","quote":"Change the measured quantity from absolute properties to paired differences: compute Δη and Δλ between molecule pairs with an identical protocol, where shared systematic error partially cancels, and score sign agreement against measured differences. Compute then buys correct ordering decisions rather than absolute accuracy.","reason":"Differencing molecule pairs changes the scored quantity to sign agreement, so compute buys ordering decisions instead of re-measuring the same absolute bias."},{"index":2,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"NA","quote":"Change the unit of work: screen with self-diffusion from the Einstein relation (converges roughly an order of magnitude faster than Green-Kubo viscosity) plus density, and reserve expensive Green-Kubo runs for survivors of a funnel... compute changes which candidates advance rather than polishing a capped estimate.","reason":"Swaps the computed screening quantity to fast-converging diffusion, so each dollar buys funnel depth, changing which candidates advance rather than averaging."},{"index":3,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"NA","quote":"Change the objective to a yes/no decision — is candidate X better than the incumbent coolant on both η and λ? — and unfix the field minimally by learning a class-conditional correction... more compute moves candidates across the decision line instead of shrinking error bars on a capped global rank.","reason":"Redefines objective to binary decisions with a learned correction, so compute resolves decision boundaries instead of polishing a capped global rank correlation."}]}
